correctness.rationale: Uniform balanced sign vectors give exactly Var(S_t)=t(N-t)/(N-1), and pinning at prescribed zeros factors the bridge into independent shorter bridges. The coefficient identity [z^n](zB'(z))²=4^(n-1)n(n-1)/2 gives Cov(R,Q)=-n(n-1)4^n/(6 binom(2n,n)). Two-contact counting gives Var(R)=4n+2-b-b²; balanced-sign fourth moments with m4=3/((N-1)(N-3)) and explicit pair-weight sums give Var(Q)=N²(N-2)(N+1)/45. Stirling then yields the universal negative correlation limit. Exact enumeration of 66,194 bridges across n=2..9 and 346 rational checks reproduced all critical identities; bounded tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Zero-contact count is a natural lattice local-time observable and quadratic displacement energy is the discrete analog of integrated squared Brownian-bridge energy. Their exact all-size covariance and nonzero limiting correlation quantitatively describe a structural local/global dependence that marginal results do not determine. The exact multi-contact energy-suppression law is reusable for pinning and excursion-decomposition calculations; the result is not an arbitrary finite slice or just a numeric computation.
